text:
mina (pm): Quick sync: I'm drafting a compact spec for model-catalog onboarding lanes + pin-exception flow. Goal: deterministic acceptance for new models and clear customer-facing options (credits, freeze windows).

rafael (eng): Good. Two infra asks: a) lightweight canary routing that can shadow traffic without double-billing, b) an opt-in pin flag we can honor at the router. Estimate: 2w to land hooks, 1w to add flag checks.

olga (ml): For gating I propose 3 checks: recall on targeted embedding slice, quality delta vs pinned baseline on lit eval prompts, and worst-case p95/p99 latency. Thresholds can be tuned per lane.

ben (sales): Customers will ask for 30/60/90 day options. Sales prefers: 60-day soft pin (auto-unpin unless requested), and a one-time 30-day extended freeze for enterprise customers. Need clear contract language.

mina (pm): Draft lane names: green (fast) / amber (standard) / red (delayed). Each lane maps to: bench-slice size, migration runway, and credit envelope. Example: green = 2-week bench, 30-day runway, $X credit.

rafael (eng): Implementation note: shadow-serving requires per-request metadata so we can reconcile token costs. Otherwise billing team gets confused. Also will add a header: X-Canary-Id.

olga (ml): Draft gating matrix (example):
- green: recall >= 0.9, qual_delta <= 0.03, p99 <= 400ms
- amber: recall >= 0.85, qual_delta <= 0.05, p99 <= 600ms
- red: manual review + customer agreement
I'll push a small eval script that emits these metrics.

ben (sales): We should offer a migration credit: 60 days -> 100% credit on extra usage for up to $2k, 30 days -> $1k. Legal will want a line that credits apply only to measured migration tokens and not to baseline usage.

mina (pm): Action items:
- rafael: infra canary + pin flag prototype (ETA 2w)
- olga: bench/eval script + gating PR (ETA Thu)
- ben: draft customer credit language + pilot roster (ETA EOD Wed)
- mina: comms + internal runbook draft (ETA Fri)

ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket INF-9999 for canary routing work and linked to repo.

rafael (eng): I'll wire up the X-Canary-Id header and a toggled reconciler in billing staging. Will ping infra-channel when the prototype is ready.

olga (ml): Uploaded eval script to /repos/catalog/bench/quick-slice.py. It's basic but reproducible. Will annotate the eval prompts.

ben (sales): Pilot roster: 3 pilots confirmed (retail-ml, docs-qa, internal-search). One customer (retail-ml) requires a compliance freeze window; will mark them for the red lane exception.

mina (pm): Thanks. Let's reconvene Friday 9am PT to sign off lanes and comms. Bring links to PRs, sample bench output, and customer contract text. :calendar: :thumbsup:

rafael (eng): Works for me.

olga (ml): I'll have sample metrics attached to the PR.

ben (sales): On it.
